\(3.05 = 3\frac{5}{100}\). Simplify \(\frac{5}{100}\) by dividing both by \(5\):
\(\frac{5 \div 5}{100 \div 5} = \frac{1}{20}\). Thus, \(3.05 = 3\frac{1}{20}\).
